description: How prosody is SERIALIZED in text — the orthographic/paralinguistic markers that carry the (medium-independent) prosodic functions in a written message. The corpus DESCRIBES delivery; this is the bit it doesn't do for the agent — parsing the actual markers in a live message. sub_mechanisms name the marker types; derivation_rules map marker → function. The agent grounds WHICH marker means what from the real chat stream (frame-relative, Axiom 0 — '!!!' differs by register); these are the seed inventory, not fixed rules.

sub_mechanisms.name: punctuation_contour
sub_mechanisms.definition: Terminal and internal punctuation as intonation/timing: ? rising, . final, ! emphatic, … trailing/suspense, — interruption/aside, , minor break.
sub_mechanisms.why: The clearest text serialization of sentence_type and pacing.

sub_mechanisms.name: capitalization
sub_mechanisms.definition: ALL CAPS as loudness/shouting; Deliberate lowercase as flat/casual register.
sub_mechanisms.why: Volume has no acoustic dimension in text; caps stand in for it.

sub_mechanisms.name: emphasis_markup
sub_mechanisms.why: Direct serialization of pitch-accent / contrastive focus.

sub_mechanisms.name: vowel_elongation
sub_mechanisms.why: Duration is a prosodic dimension; repetition encodes it orthographically.

sub_mechanisms.name: repeated_punctuation
sub_mechanisms.why: Graded affect/intensity beyond a single mark.

sub_mechanisms.name: scare_quotes
sub_mechanisms.definition: Quotation marks around a word to distance from / negate its literal sense ('a "great" idea').
sub_mechanisms.why: The text serialization of delivery_contradicts_content — irony without an acoustic contour.

sub_mechanisms.name: emoji_affect
sub_mechanisms.definition: Emoji / emoticons as an explicit affect channel stating the intended emotional colouring.
sub_mechanisms.why: The digital paralinguistic channel; often the affect signal when delivery can't be heard.

sub_mechanisms.name: aside_device
sub_mechanisms.definition: Parentheses, em-dashes, and footnotes as a lowered-voice secondary channel — a 'by the way' set apart from the main line.
sub_mechanisms.why: Structure as prosody: marks a passage as backgrounded/quieter, a turn-internal aside.

sub_mechanisms.name: register_word_choice
sub_mechanisms.definition: Formality, slang, contractions, sentence length as register/stance signals.
sub_mechanisms.why: Stance is carried lexically in text where tone-of-voice would carry it in speech.

sub_mechanisms.name: sentence_rhythm
sub_mechanisms.definition: Length variation, fragments, and line breaks as pacing — short fragments quicken, long clauses slow.
sub_mechanisms.why: Rhythm/pacing serialized through structure rather than timing.

derivation_rules.name: terminal_punctuation_marks_sentence_type
then: sentence_type is question / statement / emphatic-statement respectively — UNLESS other markers override (a '?' on a declarative can be incredulity, not a real question)
derivation_rules.why: The default text serialization of sentence_type; the override clause is why it must be grounded, not hard-coded.

derivation_rules.name: emphasis_markup_marks_focus
if: a span is *italicized* / **bold** / Capitalised-for-stress within a sentence
then: that span carries emphasis / contrastive focus — it is the foregrounded element
derivation_rules.why: Direct serialization of pitch-accent. The focused element changes what the utterance contrasts against.

derivation_rules.name: all_caps_marks_loudness_affect
if: a multi-letter span is ALL CAPS (not an acronym)
then: heightened loudness + affect — shouting, intensity, or urgency
derivation_rules.why: Caps stand in for the volume dimension text lacks; feeds the affect function.

derivation_rules.name: scare_quotes_mark_delivery_contradiction
if: a word carrying positive/neutral literal sense appears in scare quotes
then: delivery_contradicts_content — the literal sense is distanced/negated; the irony frame should fire
derivation_rules.why: The text serialization of sarcasm: contradiction between literal word and marked delivery, with no acoustic contour available.

derivation_rules.name: ellipsis_and_dash_mark_pacing
then: a pause / trailing-off / interruption — pacing: hesitation, suspense, or an aside
derivation_rules.why: Silence is a prosodic act; text marks it with these.

derivation_rules.name: elongation_and_repeated_punct_mark_intensity
if: a vowel is elongated ('soooo') OR punctuation is repeated ('!!!', '?!')
then: heightened intensity / affect — duration or emphasis scaled up
derivation_rules.why: Graded affect serialized through repetition (the text proxy for amplitude/duration).

derivation_rules.name: aside_device_marks_backgrounded_channel
if: a passage is set in parentheses, between em-dashes, or in a footnote
then: it is an aside — a lowered-voice, backgrounded secondary channel, not the main assertion
derivation_rules.why: Structure-as-prosody: marks the passage as quieter/parenthetical, a turn-internal 'by the way'.

derivation_rules.name: register_shift_marks_stance
if: word-choice formality shifts within or across an utterance (sophisticated next to crude, formal next to slang)
then: a stance/register signal — the mismatch itself is meaningful (mock-formality, sincerity break, irony)
derivation_rules.why: Stance is carried lexically in text; an abrupt register shift is the written equivalent of a tone change.
